release_notes:
⚡ Playback & Resume Speedups
• Fast-path saved stream probe on Continue Watching & Resume: instantly plays verified working streams without re-scraping
• Seamless resume from Subtitle Settings: stream re-prepares at the exact position instead of stopping

🔧 Storage & Download Permissions
• Added READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE and WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE manifest declarations for .mkv/.mp4 download output
• Unified permission request at launch (notification + storage) via DownloadStorageHelper
• Download folder picker now pre-requests missing storage permissions before opening SAF
• Friendly folder path labels ("Internal Storage > Download", "SD Card > …")

🔗 Google Drive Sync Fix
• drive.appdata OAuth scope now requested at Google Sign-In — no more 403 access_denied on fresh installs
• Clear actionable dialog when app is in Google Testing mode: instructs user to sign out/in or contact developer
• Improved 403 error classification (disabled vs access_denied vs other)

🖥️ UI Stability
• Fixed black screen on low-end devices (ConstraintLayout match_parent → 0dp MATCH_CONSTRAINT)
• Search, Login, Sign-up, Edit-profile, Welcome, Feed carousel, My List card layouts patched
